Tiring watch some useful tips for people travelling soon
Please read this before you travel
Travel Notice for Animal Passengers

Travelers must confirm all animal travel details before departure and bring every required document in order. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is issuing this urgent notice because checks at the airport are strict and incomplete preparation can cause delay.

Carry suitable crates, secure water access, and keep each animal calm throughout the journey. <<FACT F063>> Review the carrier build, the animal's condition, and the route in advance so our staff can clear the booking without avoidable interruption. Small dogs must meet all acceptance rules before they are accepted for travel. <<FACT F074>>

For rabbits, the health certificate must remain valid when presented. <<FACT F082>> Keep the certificate with the animal papers and show it at check-in without hesitation. If any detail is unclear, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at once.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
